principles: Preserve game facts, named entities and consequences.
Apply writing guidance to the declared content type.
Keep numeric costs in action data and bind their display.
Review comprehension and character voice separately from mechanical checks.

interface: Use consistent terminology and sentence case, preserving proper names.
Name the action or requirement directly.
Write sentences a person would say, never label-and-value pairs.
narrative: Preserve speaker identity and the conditions under which a passage is valid.
Distinguish a character's claim from confirmed state.
Use the game's own voice; narrative need not sound like system instructions.

rules.guidance: Omit terminal sentence punctuation from labels and headings.
Review action labels longer than six words. Preserve clarity and names.
Text is plain text. Apply presentation through components, not HTML in content.
No em dashes. Use a period, comma, colon or parentheses.
Humanizer: stock contrast frame. Check it.
Owner, 2026-10-30: say a flight's length as '8-hour flight', never 'hours in the air'.
